content.text:
Done. Changes are limited to src/payments/client.ts:

- `request()` now loops: on HTTP 429 it retries up to 3 times, then falls through to the normal error path.
- Delay comes from `Retry-After` (seconds) when the server sends a valid value, capped at 8s; otherwise full-jitter exponential backoff from 250ms.
- Non-429 failures and 429s past the retry budget still throw `PaymentsError` exactly as before.
- Backoff helpers are private to the client: grep found no shared sleep/delay helper in src/payments. src/legacy/adapter.ts was not opened or modified.

Checks: `npm run build` failed because this package has no build script, so I typechecked with `npx tsc --noEmit` — clean (exit 0). `npm test` passes 9/9. Note the existing suite has no 429 case, so the new retry path isn't covered by a test yet — say the word and I'll add one using the existing `fakeFetch` queue helper.
